changes.what_changed: The Team plan moved from a flat 299 USD per month to 49 USD per seat per month, and the free tier dropped from 3 agents to 1.
changes.so_what: Per-seat pricing gets expensive past six seats, so our flat team price is now the cheaper option for most GTM teams; lead with it in head-to-head deals.

changes.what_changed: Sample Automate launched Agent Studio, a chat interface for building agents, in public beta.
changes.so_what: It overlaps chat-built agents, our clearest difference; prospects comparing the two need a side-by-side on time-to-first-agent.

changes.what_changed: Sample Automate published a case study with Example Payroll, a 120-person B2B startup, on automating lead routing.
changes.so_what: The customer is in our segment and the use case is lead routing; check whether lead routing is in our template gallery.
